name: pogo-calendar
description: A Pokémon GO event calendar with current raid bosses, egg pools, research tasks, and Rocket lineups, plus tools for storage search strings, type matchups, event bonuses, and finding where to get any Pokémon. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and FullCalendar.

paragraphs: A comprehensive React application for tracking Pokémon GO events and game data. This project evolved from a simple calendar display into a full-featured platform with interactive calendar views, data reference pages, advanced filtering, custom event management, and a modern, responsive user interface.
features: Multiple Views: View events in responsive month and weekly list views, powered by FullCalendar.
Configurable Calendar Display: Choose an automatic, month, or list default view; set the first day of the week; and show or hide event times in month view.
Optional Event History: Load every yearly archive of official events published by leak-duck, only when enabled in Settings.
Theme Modes: Choose a light, dark, or automatic system theme with persistence in localStorage.
Custom Dark Mode Theming: Thoroughly styled dark mode that covers all aspects of the calendar, including headers and pop-ups.
